# dsh-codex-reasoning-router

PURPOSE: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin + preset. Luna executes; tool-less Sol advises.
REPO: https://github.com/chenmzh/dsh-codex-reasoning-router
LICENSE: Apache-2.0

RUNTIME:
- root executor = openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna
- advisor = openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol
- preset id = luna-sol-reasoning-router
- plugin id/name = reasoning-router / dsh-codex-reasoning-router
- first user turn: Sol advice completes before Luna request
- later blocker: Luna may call sol_consult
- same issue: at most 2 successful calls; default effort medium then high
- default provider failure behavior: fail open; Luna continues

HARD INVARIANTS:
- Sol receives no tools and no sessionId.
- Sol never edits, executes, delegates, or replies to the user.
- Any Sol tool-call block is rejected and never dispatched.
- Luna owns tools, files, MCP, skills, subagents, verification, and final answer.
- Plugin attaches only to a root session whose durable preset id matches.
- Main route must be openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna; mismatch is blocked, not rewritten.
- Consultation state is restored from append-only session events.

REQUIREMENTS:
- current DeepSeek Harness
- authenticated dsh-codex >=0.2.3
- model access: gpt-5.6-luna + gpt-5.6-sol on openai-codex
- development only: Node.js 22 + pnpm; adjacent ../dsh-codex checkout for link devDependency
- exact peer APIs: package.json#peerDependencies

INSTALL_FROM_GITHUB:
1. pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-codex
2. pnpm --dir <DSH_HOME>/profiles/web add github:chenmzh/dsh-codex-reasoning-router
3. copy <DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-codex-reasoning-router/preset/luna-sol-reasoning-router to <DSH_HOME>/.agent-presets/
4. restart DSH
5. create a new session; select preset "Luna + Sol Reasoning Router" and model openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna
Do not add this package to dsh.profile.bundles. It is mounted by the preset.

CONFIG: preset/luna-sol-reasoning-router/agent.cordis.yml
- initialSolReasoning: medium|high; default medium
- escalatedSolReasoning: medium|high; default high
- solAdviceMaxTokens: 256..4096; default 2000
- solTimeoutMs: 1000..120000; default 30000
- initialConsultEnabled: boolean; default true
- failOpen: boolean; default true

CODE MAP:
- src/advisor.ts: isolated Sol request; no tools/session; output protocol
- src/router.ts: first-turn and blocker consultation state machine
- src/tool.ts: fixed sol_consult schema
- src/state.ts: issue fingerprints and durable restore
- src/events.ts: session event registration
- src/index.ts: plugin config and lifecycle wiring
- preset/luna-sol-reasoning-router/: complete opt-in preset
- tests/router.spec.ts: invariant tests

VERIFY:
- pnpm run typecheck
- pnpm run test
- pnpm run build
- pnpm pack --dry-run

READ NEXT ONLY IF NEEDED:
- Human Chinese quickstart: README.zh-CN.md
- Detailed English design/API notes: README.md
